Real E2E test: subprocess ServerProcess + real Postgres testcontainer + sibling customer DB (avoids sqlx migration-table version collision between system and customer migrators) + POST /admin/v1/projects provisioning + real tonic gRPC Listen bidi stream (unbounded per-connection loop = genuinely still-executing in-flight request, no artificial delay added to production code). Ran against current (unmodified) main.rs/lib.rs: FAILED for genuine business-logic reason — assertion left=Some(0) right=None at line 221, proving the server exits via a fixed sleep(200ms) regardless of the still-open in-flight connection (not a compile/import/collection error).

Root cause confirmed: crates/embyr-server/src/lib.rs spawn_all_servers() raced grpc_fut/rest_task/admin_fut/shutdown_rx in one tokio::select!, dropping grpc_fut immediately on shutdown signal instead of draining it; main.rs then only slept a fixed 200ms before process exit regardless of open connections. Fix: spawn_all_servers now runs the gRPC server (tonic serve_with_incoming_shutdown) as its own task with its own shutdown oneshot — on the outer signal it stops accepting new connections but keeps already-open streams (e.g. an in-flight Listen subscription) running until they close naturally, then returns a JoinHandle. main.rs Step 14 now awaits that JoinHandle instead of an arbitrary sleep, so the process only exits once genuinely in-flight requests have drained. Ran full pr04_graceful_shutdown suite (3/3 pass) and pr01 walking skeleton (server_starts_with_all_required_env_vars_set, pass) — no regressions. cargo build --workspace --tests: clean (pre-existing unrelated warnings only).
